defensiveAbilities.name: Death Throes
defensiveAbilities.description: When the gold defender is destroyed, it melts into worthless slag. As it melts, it releases a 10ft Burst cloud of fumes and a 10-foot radius puddle of molten metal. Creatures that breathe fumes are exposed to gold defender poison. Creatures that move through the puddle take 10d6 Fire Damage damage. The fumes dissipate after 1 round and the puddle cools after 1 minute.

defensiveAbilities.name: Golem Antimagic
defensiveAbilities.description:
Harmed by cold (6d10 Untyped Damage, 2d8 Untyped Damage from areas or persistent damage); healed by fire (area 2d8 Healing Damage HP); slowed by acid

See rules...

A golem is immune to spells and magical abilities other than its own, but each type of golem is affected by a few types of magic in special ways. These exceptions are listed in shortened form in the golem's stat block, with the full rules appearing here. If an entry lists multiple types (such as "cold and water"), either type of spell can affect the golem.

  • Harmed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to take the listed amount of damage (this damage has no type) instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of magic of this type or is affected by a persistent effect of the appropriate type, it takes the damage listed in the parenthetical.
  • Healed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem makes the golem lose the slowed condition and gain HP equal to half the damage the spell would have dealt. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it gains the HP listed in the parenthetical.
  • Slowed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to be Slowed 1 for 2d6 rounds instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it's slowed 1 for that round.
  • Vulnerable To Each golem is vulnerable to one or more specific spells, with the effects described in its stat block.

defensiveAbilities.name: Malleable Shape
defensiveAbilities.description: The gold defender's body is made from soft gold, which is particularly pliable. If the gold defender is critically hit with an attack that deals bludgeoning damage, the attack partially bends and reshapes the gold defender. The gold defender becomes Clumsy 2 until it spends an Interact action to bend itself back into shape.

defensiveAbilities.name: Vulnerable to Telekinetic Haul
defensiveAbilities.description: Casting Telekinetic Haul on the gold defender squeezes its form, compressing it into a smaller and much more awkward shape. The gold defender becomes Clumsy 3 and can't use Light Reflection. The gold defender must take a 1-minute activity, which has the manipulate trait, to restore its shape, removing the clumsy condition and restoring its Light Reflection.

offensiveAbilities.name: Gold Defender Poison
offensiveAbilities.description:
Any Drained value from this poison is reduced by 1 every hour

Saving Throw DC 33 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 2d6 Poison Damage and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 4d6 Poison Damage and Drained 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 8d6 Poison Damage and Drained 3 (1 round).

offensiveAbilities.name: Inexorable March
offensiveAbilities.description: The gold defender Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a DC 37 Fortitude Saving Throw save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise, it is damaged as if hit by the defender's fist Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Light Reflection
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The gold defender is not in darkness

Effect The gold defender reshapes its skin into a reflective surface that magnifies ambient light into a precise beam that burns all creatures in a 30ft Cone, dealing 14d6 Fire Damage damage (DC 31 Reflex Saving Throw save if the gold defender is in dim light, DC 33 Reflex Saving Throw save if it's in bright light). It can't use Light Reflection again for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and catches fire, taking 1d6 Persistent,fire Damage damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the persistent fire damage is 5d6 Persistent,fire Damage.
